scenarios.name: Select visible available commands with the keyboard

scenario_steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software with the full Tools ribbon visible
ribbon customization shows All Commands and an empty Part Tools target
the user selects 2D Sketches in the available command list
the user presses Ctrl+A while the available command list has focus
every currently visible available-command row is highlighted
the Part Tools target remains empty
the user clicks 3D Annotations in the available command list
the other currently visible available-command rows are not highlighted
the Part Tools target remains empty
